name: Annealed Shaper Bond
flavorText: "I will always protect the Black Armory, above all else." —Ada-1

name: Annealed Shaper Boots
flavorText: "Move quickly. The world never waits." —Ada-1

name: Annealed Shaper Crown
flavorText: "Peel back the layers of hesitance to yield the fruit of conviction." —Ada-1

name: Annealed Shaper Gloves
flavorText: "Some things in the universe are unknowable. What matters is that they're destructible." —Ada-1

name: Annealed Shaper Robes
flavorText: "A fire cannot burn forever. The embers crack and dance, then drift softly into the ether." —Ada-1

name: Annihilating Greaves
flavorText: "For the Light who seeks to be immovable." —Emissary of the Nine
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

name: Annihilating Guard
flavorText: "For the Light who exercises brute force to win an exchange." —Emissary of the Nine
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

name: Annihilating Helm
flavorText: "For one who seeks to use their head in a fight." —Emissary of the Nine
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

name: Annihilating Plate
flavorText: "For one who willingly bleeds for the chance to destroy their opponent." —Emissary of the Nine
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

name: Antaeus Wards
flavorText: Do you believe in the Gaiaforms, the energies within planets?
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Reflective Vents
exoticPerk.description: While sliding with full class ability energy, you gain a frontal shield that reflects incoming damage. After reflecting damage, your class ability energy is depleted based on the amount of damage reflected.

name: Anti-Extinction Boots
flavorText: "The role of Arach is not a gift, not an honor, but a curse and a pledge of service. Many seek it nevertheless." —The Book of Departures, Canto I
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Gauntlets
flavorText: "The instinct to migrate comes to many at once, without warning. Unlike birds, we must make preparations—we must make our own wings." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Gloves
flavorText: "The possibility of return is slender but present. That, however, is a decision for the future." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Grasps
flavorText: "As birds are touched by a sudden and invisible instinct to fly to safer ground, so are we." —The Book of Departures, Canto VII
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Greaves
flavorText: "Even for the faithless Arach, there is hope. While there is space on the ships, none shall be turned away." —The Book of Departures, Canto XII
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Helm
flavorText: "Friends and families must be cast aside if they do not perceive the truth. Such ties bind us more tightly than gravity." —The Book of Departures, Canto III
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Hood
flavorText: "Isolation is not good for the Arach. Our enemies often accuse us of madness, and we cannot give them grounds. One must trust others." —The Book of Departures, Canto III
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Legs
flavorText: "Some Arachs turn from their path and embrace the Earth as home. One and all, they are bitterly disappointed." —The Book of Departures, Canto XII
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Mask
flavorText: "Let us describe the art of mapping a dream. First, all former dreams must be crushed. This makes the ink with which we draw." —The Book of Departures, Canto III
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Plate
flavorText: "To be selected as an Arach, one must have a clear vision of the future and its horrors." —The Book of Departures, Canto I
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Robes
flavorText: "We are not a faction but a movement. At heart, we desire survival for all. This point is poorly understood." —The Book of Departures, Canto XII
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Extinction Vest
flavorText: "Our fundamental principle, to which all the Arachs must swear, is emigration." —The Book of Departures, Canto I
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Anti-Hero Victory
flavorText: The unlikely champion rises from tragedy.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Apostate's Blade Bond
flavorText: The mathematics of war was ever written in blood.

name: Apostate's Blade Boots
flavorText: There are no words.

flavorText: Tend the gardens of your heart.

exoticPerk.name: And Another Thing

flavorText:

 —Aodh, Second Empyreal Magistrate of the Sunbreaker
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Bring the Heat
exoticPerk.description: Fusion Grenades gain increased throw speed, explode on impact, and stun Unstoppable Champions. Final blows with Fusion Grenades grant grenade energy.

name: Assassin's Cowl
flavorText: Now you see me. Now you don't.

exoticPerk.name: Vanishing Execution
exoticPerk.description: Powered melee final blows grant invisibility and restore a portion of health and shields. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the duration of the invisibility and the amount of health and shields restored.

name: Astrocyte Verse
flavorText: The ideocosm contained within this helm transforms the wearer's head from flesh and/or exoneurons to the pure, raw stuff of thought.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Move to Survive
exoticPerk.description:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.

exoticPerk.description:
Weighted Knife gains a second bounce. Rapid precision hits with your weapons grant Weighted Knife a significant damage bonus, bonus melee, and the ability to stun unshielded combatants for a short time.

Empowered Weighted Knife is strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

name: Attendant's Mark
flavorText: – Hold the moment until eternity becomes a prison of violent positivity –

name: Balance of Power
flavorText: "In my mind I heard it whisper: 'come and see.'"

exoticPerk.name: Double Down
exoticPerk.description: Your Threaded Specter has increased duration and durability, and damaging it releases additional Threadlings. While near your Threaded Specter, you do not appear on radar.

name: Ballidorse Wrathweavers
flavorText: They do not yet know what true cold is.

exoticPerk.name: Hearts of Ice
exoticPerk.description: Targets frozen by your Winter's Wrath Super take increased Shatter damage. Allies in range of your Winter's Wrath shockwave and Frostpulse gain Frost Armor and deal increased damage with Stasis weapons. Granting these buffs to allies grants you Super energy.

name: Be Thy Champion
flavorText: An honored gift, given to those who stand as pillars of hope.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Be Thy Cipher

sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Be Thy Guide

sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

flavorText: The phoenix that fights itself, then rises from its ashes stronger than ever. That is the Crucible.
sourceString: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.

name: Bladesmith's Memory Cloak
flavorText: "We hold onto traditions like memories. They define us. They remind us of those we've lost." —Y. Satou
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Bladesmith's Memory Grips
flavorText: "Tradition binds us. It keeps us in line. It is the foundation of family, and the Black Armory is a family." —Y. Satou
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Bladesmith's Memory Mask
flavorText: "The Black Armory celebrates who we are. Who we all are. We design all of our gear after our traditions. They carry our legacy." —Y. Satou
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Bladesmith's Memory Strides
flavorText: "Humanity deserves to be seen as they truly are. To not allow their heritage to be forgotten." —Y. Satou
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Bladesmith's Memory Vest
flavorText: "My mother always did her best to preserve our traditions, despite the world's best attempts to destroy them." —Y. Satou
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Blastwave Striders
flavorText: Take the hits. Give the hits.
sourceString: Solo Expert and Master Lost Sectors

exoticPerk.name: Blastwave Striders
exoticPerk.description: Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.

name: Blight Ranger
flavorText: It reflects whatever it sees, no matter how ugly.

exoticPerk.name: Voltaic Mirror
exoticPerk.description: Guarding with your Arc Staff does not consume extra Super energy. [Super]  : Cancel Arc Staff early, temporarily increasing Arc weapon damage and creating a blinding burst. Reflected attacks increase the damage of the burst, extend your Super, and deal additional damage.

name: Bond Judgment (CODA)
flavorText: A metaphysical gift: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

name: Bond of Optimacy
flavorText: Has this wealth found you or have you found it?

name: Bond of Reciprocity
flavorText: "In the darkness, light shines more brightly, and where light shines, it casts a shadow." —Ulan-Tan

name: Bond of Remembrance
flavorText: To sharpen our senses when we return.
sourceString: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.

name: Bond of Sekris
flavorText: "I never forgot what I saw—the gift the Great Machine could bestow. And Calus promised me more." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Bond of the Cormorant Blade
flavorText: "Paperwork." —Warlock Aunor Mahal, on the most devastating adversary of her Praxic career.

name: Bond of the Emperor's Minister
flavorText: For the Warlock possessed of Ghaul's wisdom.

name: Bond of the Exile
flavorText: "They who entered the Speaker's chambers as master and apprentice were bitter rivals when they left." —Brother Vance

name: Bond of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be respected.

name: Bond of the Taken King
flavorText: "If I fail, let me be worm food."

name: Bond of the Wormlore
flavorText: "They were two once. In the Darkness, they joined. Such is the Hive's strength. And such is their hunger." —Eris Morn

name: Bond Relentless
flavorText: "For you as much as for them. They are observing your thoughts." —Emissary of the Nine
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

setBonuses.name: Power of the Son

name: Boots of Ascendancy

flavorText: "The fiercest Light emerged from the tangle of the web grenade. The amethyst divider on his helmet gleamed with rage. I was gone by then. I'm no fool." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Boots of the Ace-Defiant
flavorText: “We armed the Sindu with a fleet of golden ships. Their interceptors are a shield for the Leviathan, as the Shadows are my sword.” —Emperor Calus

name: Boots of the Assembler

exoticPerk.name: Blessing of Order
exoticPerk.description: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.

name: Boots of the Cormorant Blade
flavorText: "The Hidden are everywhere. You might know one or two." —Warlock Aunor Mahal

name: Boots of the Emperor's Agent
flavorText: You're a difficult one to find.

name: Boots of the Emperor's Minister
flavorText: It's all for the sake of appearances.

name: Boots of the Exile

name: Boots of the Fulminator

name: Boots of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be sure-footed.

name: Boots of the Taken King
flavorText: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."

name: BrayTech Iron-Heart Engine

name: BrayTech Researcher's Bond
flavorText: Keeping our greatest minds safe and warm.

name: BrayTech Researcher's Boots
flavorText: Snow is snow is snow. Right?

name: BrayTech Researcher's Gloves
flavorText: Warm hands, warm heart.

name: BrayTech Researcher's Hood
flavorText: Featuring the latest in autocorrecting lens technology.

name: BrayTech Researcher's Robes
flavorText: I tend to work better while not freezing to death.

name: BrayTech Sn0Boots
flavorText: "Nonslip techno treads for maximum arctic mobility."

name: BrayTech Sn0Helm
flavorText: Great for avoiding a brain freeze.

name: BrayTech Sn0Mask
flavorText: "This is our best work yet." —Project Manager, BrayTech R&D

name: BrayTech Sn0Treads
flavorText: "Piecing together complex systems of causalities is the puzzle that defined me." —Elsie Bray

name: BrayTech Survival Mitts
flavorText: "Stand over here. Stick your arm out. Yes, perfect. OK, just hold still…" —Production Lead, BrayTech R&D

name: BrayTech Thermal Grips
flavorText: "You think this is cold? You have no idea."

name: BrayTech Winter Cloak
flavorText: "Not every piece of equipment is optimal for all environments. You see snow. I see a thousand hiding places." —Designer, BrayTech R&D

name: Briarbinds
flavorText: New growth rises from the old.

name: Bulletsmith's Ire Gauntlets

sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Bulletsmith's Ire Greaves
flavorText: "Their tools of war could be put to better use. The Armory has the ideas. They have the technology. Seems like a perfect match." —H. Rasmussen

name: Bulletsmith's Ire Helm

name: Bulletsmith's Ire Mark
flavorText: "Humanity will need protection. The Black Armory will provide." —H. Rasmussen
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Bulletsmith's Ire Plate
flavorText: "It's not enough, what we've built. The Black Armory can be bigger. Better. It will be. It has to be." —H. Rasmussen

exoticPerk.name: Crystalline Transistor
exoticPerk.description:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.

name: Contraverse Hold
flavorText: "Nothing is free. I know that. Therefore, he knows it too. If our places were swapped, he would do the same." —Tomek I
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Chaotic Exchanger
exoticPerk.description: Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.

name: Coronation Bond
flavorText: "The sign of New Monarchy should come to mean comfort, safety, and strength." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 1
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Coronation Cloak
flavorText: "When the dream is fulfilled and the day has come to crown a leader, spectacle and pomp are fitting. Spend lavishly." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 1
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Coronation Mark
flavorText: "The greatest merits are found within. But even these are better displayed by sumptuous dress and a sense of style." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 1
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Corrupting Echo Robes

name: Cover of the Exile

name: Cowl of Righteousness
flavorText: "You say this is for the greater good. Which good have you deemed lesser?" —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

setBonuses.name: Network Admin
setBonuses.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.

setBonuses.name: Network Upload
setBonuses.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.

name: Crest of Alpha Lupi
flavorText: Whoever survives our passing does so only by our consent.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Survival Well
exoticPerk.description: Generates an additional Orb of Power from Supers. Generating a Barricade, or dealing sustained damage or defeating targets from behind one creates a healing pulse. Healing your allies grants Barricade energy.

exoticPerk.description:
While you have an Arc ability equipped, Arc ability or Jolt final blows increase the recharge rate of your abilities and extend the duration of Stormtrance.

While you have Conduction Tines, Ionic Sentry creates a Storm Grenade when it deploys.

setBonuses.name: Between Poles
setBonuses.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.

setBonuses.name: So Very Thin

name: Entanglement Bond
flavorText: "A dazzling flash. Blinding. All-consuming. I saw nothing more." —RECORD 460-CHASM-1004

name: Entanglement Cloak
flavorText: "I see six armies, locked in battle, across far systems. Now I see four armies. And now I see one." —RECORD 579-CHASM-3360

name: Entanglement Mark
flavorText: "A hand, lying on the grass, in one future. A head in another. Components scattered across six visions. All identifiable. I agree. We cannot tell her. Take this off the—" —RECORD 784-CHASM-1016

name: Equitis Shade Boots
flavorText: "There has only been a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Equitis Shade Cloak
flavorText: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. They should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Equitis Shade Cowl
flavorText: "You have truly grown fat from strength. And you are still as nimble as ever. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Equitis Shade Grips
flavorText: "Ace pilots. Assassination squads. Swift thieves in the night. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Equitis Shade Rig
flavorText: "A little faster. A little more lethal. You are almost ready… to cast a Shadow." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Ere the End

name: Falcon-Wing Boots
flavorText: Protector only of what I choose.

name: Falcon-Wing Cover

name: Falcon-Wing Gloves
flavorText: Ever diving towards my prey.

name: Falcon-Wing Robes

name: Fallen Sunstar

name: Forged Machinist Gauntlets
flavorText: "Humanity can only rely upon itself in these dire times." —Ada-1

name: Forged Machinist Greaves
flavorText: "A forge represents limitless opportunity." —Ada-1

name: Forged Machinist Helm
flavorText: "Home is where the Hand Cannon is." —Ada-1

name: Forged Machinist Mark
flavorText: "You never know what lies ahead." —Ada-1

name: Forged Machinist Plate
flavorText: "Temper your resolve like gunmetal, because you must become the true weapon." —Ada-1

name: Fortune's Favor
flavorText: Don't call it a lucky streak. You're just that good.

exoticPerk.name: Kismet
exoticPerk.description:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.

name: Fr0st-EE5
flavorText: "Hey, if it works for computers…" —Marcus Ren
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Rapid Cooldown
exoticPerk.description:
Increases grenade, melee, and dodge regeneration while sprinting.

Gain stacks of Frost Armor while sprinting. When you have Frost Armor, Stasis weapons deal additional damage.

name: Fragment of the Prime
flavorText: Caged in ascendant motes, it still glimmers with the light of some ceaseless calculation.

name: Frostreach Bond

name: Frostreach Hood
flavorText: "During the Festival of the Lost, we look back. During the Dawning, we look forward." —Ikora Rey

name: Frostreach Robes

flavorText: You put the "snicker" in "snicker-snack."

name: Frumious Strides

sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Ikora Rey.

name: Frumious Vest
flavorText: When have you ever known Hunters to do as they were told?
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Ikora Rey.

flavorText: Seek height, gain sanctuary.

flavorText: See strife, seek balance.

name: Fused Aurum Mark
flavorText: Rest often, rest well.

flavorText: Find warmth, take heart.

flavorText: "Do I miss my arm? I miss my empire. I would give everything to have it back. And I will." —Valus Nohr
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Gauntlets of Rull
flavorText: “Calus had won. But he took nothing from us. Instead he gave us everything we needed to end our perpetual war.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.

name: Gauntlets of the Emperor's Champion
flavorText: I will be the last light to go out at the party.

name: Gauntlets of the Exile
flavorText: "Strengthen the body, empower the mind." —Parables of the Allspring

name: Gauntlets of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be indestructible.

name: Gauntlets of the Taken King
flavorText: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."

name: Gemini Jester
flavorText: "I love making people laugh. And by 'people,' I mean me. Haha!" "Haha! Me!"

exoticPerk.name: Misdirection

flavorText: "Congratulations on finding your true calling in life. You have been an… adequate assistant." —Asher Mir

name: Gensym Knight Casque

exoticPerk.description: Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.

name: Getaway Artist
flavorText: Keep the engine running.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Dynamic Duo
exoticPerk.description: [Grenade]  : Convert your Arc grenade into a Arc Soul and become amplified. The Arc Soul functions as an autonomous turret.

name: Gifted Conviction
flavorText: "Perfection is overvalued." —Ikora Rey

exoticPerk.name: The Gift of Certainty
exoticPerk.description: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.

name: Gloves of Exaltation
flavorText: "You're honest. You're true. If anyone can handle the responsibility of this power, it's you." —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3

name: Gloves of the Cormorant Blade
flavorText: "A Praxic blade could set the world on fire. We're very careful with our aim." —Warlock Aunor Mahal

name: Gloves of the Emperor's Agent
flavorText: You left me with nothing, but now I have everything.

name: Gloves of the Exile
flavorText: "Strengthen the body, empower the mind." —Parables of the Allspring

name: Gloves of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be lethal.

name: Gloves of the Hezen Lords
flavorText: "Capable gauntlets. Extremely effective. I have only one piece of advice: never touch a living Vex."

name: Gloves of the Taken King
flavorText: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."

setBonuses.name: The Ceremony
setBonuses.description: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.

setBonuses.name: Lucent Swarm
setBonuses.description: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.

name: Grasp of Eir
flavorText: At the beginning, they stood in thrall of the Formless One, and they offered themselves to its depth.

name: Grasps of the Flain
flavorText: – Torment rent in twain cascades upon the valleys and subjugates them again –

setBonuses.name: Sinew Stitching
setBonuses.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.

setBonuses.name: Knit Together
setBonuses.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.

name: Grasps of the Taken King
flavorText: "My great work is to die and, in that dying, live."

name: Graviton Forfeit
flavorText: "Doesn't matter how good you are—you stay out there too long, you're not coming back. Not the same way you left, anyway." —Tevis
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Vanishing Shadow
exoticPerk.description: Increases the duration of any invisibility effects. When you gain invisibility, your grenade, melee and class abilities recharge faster. At maximum stacks, you gain a Void Overshield as well.

name: Greaves of Agony
flavorText: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - IV

name: Greaves of Ascendancy
flavorText: "I know where I stand." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3

Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.

setBonuses.name: Network Upload
setBonuses.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.

name: Greaves of Nohr
flavorText: "Under Calus, this system will unite. And when the end comes, we'll be ready. All of us." —Valus Nohr
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Greaves of Rull
flavorText: “Valus Nohr marched on our capital with a few thousand. For weeks we battered them. But the Valus. She broke us.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.

name: Greaves of the Emperor's Champion
flavorText: The chorus of regret must be deafening.

name: Greaves of the Exile
flavorText: "Many followed him when he left—if not with their feet, then with their hearts." —Fractal Scrolls

name: Greaves of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be immovable.

name: Greaves of the Taken King
flavorText: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."

name: Grips of Exaltation
flavorText: "You have the hands of an artist. Fortunately for us, one of those arts is war." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

flavorText: “The Sindu fly like surgeons operate. And the Ace-Defiants are the best among them. Only one Shadowed me.” —Emperor Calus

name: Gunsmith's Devotion Bond
flavorText: "First the Traveler, and then what? What follows in its wake? We must be prepared." —H. Meyrin
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Gunsmith's Devotion Boots
flavorText: "They came for us. We were not prepared. Despite our best attempts." —H. Meyrin
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Gunsmith's Devotion Crown
flavorText: "The human condition pushes us. Moves us. We fight because we love. We die because we love." —H. Meyrin
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Gunsmith's Devotion Gloves
flavorText: "What we did, we did for humanity. For family." —H. Meyrin
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Gunsmith's Devotion Robes
flavorText: "Black market arms aren't a particularly popular subject, for obvious reasons. Some nights I lie in bed wondering if we're doing the right thing at all." —H. Meyrin
sourceString: Found in the "Scourge of the Past" raid.

name: Gwisin Vest
flavorText: "The Traveler called me back. Told me my work on this side isn't done yet." —Seong-Do Whiteclaw
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Roving Assassin
exoticPerk.description:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.

name: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk
flavorText: The higher your flight, the faster your dive.

exoticPerk.name: See Me, Feel Me
exoticPerk.description: Your Void weapons gain Volatile Rounds after you emerge from being invisible. When you are invisible and defeat a combatant while using a finisher, all of your weapons gain bonus damage; you and your nearby allies gain a reserve overshield and improved class ability regeneration. These reserve overshields can be deployed by using a class ability.

name: Hallowfire Heart
flavorText: "You who seek the Forge: your journey will be long, but your destination is closer than you think." —Ouros
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Sunfire Furnace
exoticPerk.description:
While your Solar Super is charged, ability final blows cure you and give stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, grenade and Shieldburst final blows trigger an ignition. Each stack increases grenade regeneration, class ability regeneration, and Super damage. Upon exiting your Super, all stacks are converted into Super energy.

name: Hardy's Calm
flavorText: "Watch your people, mark their strengths, and be ready to call on them."

name: Hardy's Control
flavorText: "You know what I believe? Whatever I can get my hands on."

name: Hardy's Journey
flavorText: "Listen closely to those deep, distant warnings you feel."

name: Hardy's Orders
flavorText: "In the end we'll be known for something bigger than all of us."

name: Hardy's Steps
flavorText: "I can't tell any one of you what to do. I'm not that wise. Walk your path. You'll know it."

name: Hazardous Propulsion
flavorText: WARNING: Sudden explosions may occur.

exoticPerk.name: Danger Close
exoticPerk.description: Weapon precision hits or final blows have a chance to load a Kinetic Exodus micro-missile. Activating your class ability fires loaded Exodus micro-missiles. Damaging targets with Exodus micro-missiles temporarily increases the damage you deal with other micro-missiles and Rocket Launchers.

name: Headpiece of the Emperor's Minister
flavorText: Are you just a phantom in a mirror?

name: Heart of Inmost Light
flavorText: On the cusp between life and light, between death and destruction.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Overflowing Light
exoticPerk.description: Using an ability (grenade, melee, or Barricade) empowers the other two abilities. Empowered means abilities have faster regen, melees and grenades do more damage, and Barricades have more hit points.

name: Heiro Camo
flavorText: "We are the riddlesmiths of eternity. No puzzle escapes our grasp." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Heiro Sect"
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Heiro Camo
flavorText: "We are the everlasting ray, shining brightest under the sun." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Heiro Sect"
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Heiro Camo
flavorText: "We are the trusted dawn. Long forgotten, but now returned." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Herio Sect"
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Heiro Camo
flavorText: "We are the new school. Our spectrum is bright." —Excerpt, "Charter of the Heiro Sect"
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Helm of Agony
flavorText: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - I

name: Helm of Optimacy
flavorText: From high atop humanity we watch.

name: Helm of Righteousness
flavorText: "I know what needs to done. And I'm the one to do it." —Yardarm-4, Titan of the Kentarch 3

setBonuses.name: Network Admin
setBonuses.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.

setBonuses.name: Network Upload
setBonuses.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.

name: Helm of Saint-14
flavorText: "He walked out into the demon light. But at the end he was brighter." —Paean to Saint-14
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Starless Night
exoticPerk.description:
Weapons of Light persists after exiting Ward of Dawn. While Weapons of Light is active, final blows or sustained damage grant stacks of The Saint; Void and Kinetic damage sources also trigger a suppressing burst.
 
Picking up Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its duration based on how many stacks were consumed.

name: Helm of the Ace-Defiant
flavorText: “The Sindu inhabited gas giants in the spinward marches. They refused my invitation at first. As with all things, they came to see things my way.” —Emperor Calus

name: Helm of the Emperor's Champion
flavorText: Looking for a quiet place to watch the end of the world.

name: Helm of the Exile
flavorText: "Don't you find it strange that the one called the Speaker rarely has anything useful to say?" —Sayings of the Disciples

name: Helm of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be strategic.

name: Helm of the Taken King
flavorText: "What will happen if I die?"

name: High-Minded Complex
flavorText: "The secret, I'm told, is to look inward until the stars come into focus."—The Speaker
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: High-Minded Complex
flavorText: "A curious mind is a violent thing—always at war with the unknown." —The Speaker
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: High-Minded Complex
flavorText: "Calculate infinity that it may be held and redirected for the common good." —The Speaker
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: High-Minded Complex
flavorText: "There is nothing more unknowable than all we have forgotten." —The Speaker
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Hinterland Cloak
flavorText: There is no winning the ancient game of blood, tooth, and claw.
sourceString: Randomly rewarded from completing Vanguard Ops, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.

name: Hinterland Cowl
flavorText: The beast snarls, and the hunter whispers.
sourceString: Randomly rewarded from completing Vanguard Ops, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.

name: Hinterland Grips
flavorText: The beast mauls, and the hunter waits.
sourceString: Randomly rewarded from completing Vanguard Ops, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.

name: Hinterland Strides
flavorText: The beast tramples, and the hunter stalks.
sourceString: Randomly rewarded from completing Vanguard Ops, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.

name: Hinterland Vest
flavorText: The beast postures, and the hunter watches.
sourceString: Randomly rewarded from completing Vanguard Ops, Crucible, or Gambit playlist activities.

name: Hoarfrost-Z
flavorText: "No great wonder can stand forever if it is constructed on a lie." —Alexei

exoticPerk.name: Glacial Fortification
exoticPerk.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Standing behind this barricade will grant you and your allies increased weapon reload speed, stability, and range.

name: Hodiocentrist Bond
flavorText: Hodiocentrism: the belief that the Traveler is the center of the universe.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Holdfast Bond
flavorText: "I stood on that frigid cliff, watching the smoke and flames rising from the City, and made a vow. Never again."—Ikora Rey

name: Holdfast Boots
flavorText: The plains outside the City are marred by the bones of downed ships, both Guardian and Cabal.

name: Holdfast Cloak
flavorText: Never let them see you break.

name: Holdfast Cover
flavorText: Every battle is a lesson. The true victor is the one who can learn quicker.

name: Holdfast Gauntlets
flavorText: "Stone by stone, I built this wall with my hands. I'll defend it the same way."—Lord Shaxx

name: Holdfast Gloves
flavorText: Nobody's hands will be clean in the end.

name: Holdfast Greaves
flavorText: "For five miles, we pushed through an enfilade of shock beams and web mines. Not everyone stood at the end. But enough of us did." —Callisto Yin

name: Holdfast Grips
flavorText: Brace for the coming shadow.

name: Holdfast Helm
flavorText: "I've seen enough battles at these walls. I had hoped to never see another. That hope is stretched thin now."—Lord Saladin

name: Holdfast Mark
flavorText: In rememberance of those who never saw the sun rise after battle's end.

name: Holdfast Mask
flavorText: "There's a stone cairn outside the city; been there since Six Fronts. No one visits it, but once a year, I put a fresh lily on top. I hope it brings them peace." —Shiro-4

name: Holdfast Plate
flavorText: "Do not let hope belay the act of preparation. The war is often won before the first shot is fired."—Commander Zavala

name: Holdfast Robes
flavorText: "Death will become a good friend to you here in the Gap. Do not fear it. Wield it."—Tibon

name: Holdfast Strides
flavorText: Some storms can't be outrun.

name: Holdfast Vest
flavorText: "I hit a wall on the third night. It felt like the sun would never rise over the Gap again. But it did. It always does, if you can make it just a little longer."—Ana Bray

name: Holeshot Cloak
flavorText: Getting there first is all that matters.

name: Hood of Optimacy
flavorText: From high atop humanity we watch.

name: Hooks of the Flain

setBonuses.name: Sinew Stitching
setBonuses.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.

setBonuses.name: Knit Together
setBonuses.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.

name: Husk's Cloak
flavorText: – Let the flesh become a puppet of the truer soul, with ligaments like wire –

name: Icarus Drifter Cape
flavorText:
"Don't forget who has the best Icarus–Daedalus time."

"You did it at closest approach! Doesn't count." "Does too!"
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Icarus Drifter Grips
flavorText: "Bet I can get to 15-6-6 Icarus before you can!" —Tallu Fairwind
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Icarus Drifter Legs
flavorText: "Just remember, post-crash Ghost rez in a vacuum can be, ah… complicated. So try not to die."  —Shun Endo
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Icarus Drifter Mask
flavorText: "That last flare burned my engines out. Holliday's mad at me." —Ariadne Gris
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Icarus Drifter Vest
flavorText: "You wouldn't believe the solar flare I caught the other day. Rode it halfway to Venus." —Blue Boaz
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Icefall Mantle
flavorText: Ice can grind mountains to dust. These will get the job done.

exoticPerk.name: Glacial Guard
exoticPerk.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.

name: Illuminus Cloak (Magnificent)
flavorText: Complete Legendary or Master Lost Sectors to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Illuminus Cloak (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete Glory Rank playlist activities, Nightfall strikes, or matches in Trials of Osiris.
- Collect Solar Elemental Orbs in the European Aerial Zone activity.
- Defeat powerful Cabal.

name: Illuminus Grasps (Magnificent)
flavorText: Complete any raid to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Illuminus Grasps (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021: 
- Complete Altars of Sorrow on the Moon, or Override missions from Season of the Splicer.
- Gain elemental empowerment buffs by collecting Elemental Orbs.
- Defeat combatants with Void weapons.

name: Illuminus Mask (Magnificent)
flavorText: Complete Vanguard Ops on Master or Grandmaster difficulty to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Illuminus Mask (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Defeat 5 minibosses in the European Aerial Zone before the boss is summoned.
- Collect Elemental Orbs.
- Rapidly defeat combatants.

name: Illuminus Strides (Magnificent)
flavorText: Defeat Champions or defeat Guardians in Competitive Crucible (Trials or Glory Rank playlists) to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Illuminus Strides (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete public events on Europa or Battlegrounds from Season of the Chosen.
- Collect Arc or Stasis Elemental Orbs in strike, Crucible, or Gambit playlists.
- Defeat combatants with melee attacks while using an Arc subclass.

name: Illuminus Vest (Magnificent)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete any dungeon.

name: Illuminus Vest (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete Blind Well activities in the Dreaming City or Wrathborn Hunts from Season of the Hunt.
- Collect Solstice Key Fragments.
- Defeat combatants with Solar grenades.

Each piece of event armor increases the strength of your Good Moods during the 2019 Revelry. Additional pieces can be found in the Verdant Forest or via bounties from Eva Levante.
sourceString: Earned during the seasonal Revelry event.

name: Insight Rover Boots
flavorText: Move swiftly—time is not on our side.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Rover Grips
flavorText: These hands have caused so much pain.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Rover Mask
flavorText: No living person shall know thy true face.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Rover Vest
flavorText: Within this chest beats the heart of a phantom—an apparition, a wraith, a ghost.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Unyielding Gauntlets
flavorText: Are you the immovable force, or the unstoppable object?
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Unyielding Greaves
flavorText: Glide across the battlefield like a ghost among living corpses.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Unyielding Helm
flavorText: When your enemies behold your power, let them know fear. Turn your gaze to them and let them know death.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Unyielding Plate
flavorText: Everything ends. When you meet yours, take them all with you.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Vikti Boots
flavorText: Flow gracefully like water from a mountain spring, and strike like the torrent of a raging flood.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Vikti Gloves
flavorText: "When you master the Light, it becomes an extension of your reach." —Lyssa, the Lighthearted
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Vikti Hood
flavorText: Your eyes will behold a million million wonders, and your mind will create a million million more.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insight Vikti Robes
flavorText: The body is a scaffolding for the mind. Keep the body safe and allow the mind to flourish.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Insigne Shade Bond
flavorText: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. And they should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Insigne Shade Boots
flavorText: "There has only ever been but a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Insigne Shade Cover
flavorText: "You have truly grown fat from strength. And you are still as wise as ever. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Insigne Shade Gloves
flavorText: "Warrior-scholars. Reality breakers. Weapons of mass destruction. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Insigne Shade Robes
flavorText: A little bolder. A little more focus. You are almost ready… to cast a Shadow. —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Intrepid Discovery Cloak

flavorText: Let your cunning lead you to lost relics.

name: Intrepid Discovery Strides
flavorText: Discover the unimaginable.

name: Intrepid Discovery Vest
flavorText: There is freedom in the chase.

name: Intrepid Exploit Gauntlets

name: Intrepid Exploit Helm

name: Ketchkiller's Cloak
flavorText: "Keep a radio hidden on you… and hope you never need it." —Spider

name: Ketchkiller's Gauntlets
flavorText: "Steer your ship true, as trust is rare among the deep stars." —Mithrax

name: Ketchkiller's Gloves
flavorText: "Those other fellas got more hands than you, so make sure you're holdin' bigger guns." —Drifter

name: Ketchkiller's Greaves
flavorText: "Tread your path with honor, as a true Lightbearer." —Mithrax

name: Ketchkiller's Grips
flavorText: "Being captain just means everyone has a reason to want you gone." —Spider

name: Ketchkiller's Helmet
flavorText: "Even from the deck of a Ketch, your Light can shatter the stars." —Mithrax

name: Ketchkiller's Hood
flavorText: "Every crew needs a captain. Otherwise, who'd take all the credit?" —Drifter

name: Ketchkiller's Mark
flavorText: "Not all deserve your protection, but all will have it." —Mithrax

name: Ketchkiller's Mask

name: Ketchkiller's Plate
flavorText: "You will face cutlass and cannon fire… nothing you need fear." —Mithrax

name: Ketchkiller's Robes
flavorText: "Sail quick so you don't get caught… and have a thick hull if you do." —Drifter

name: Ketchkiller's Strides

name: Ketchkiller's Vest

name: Light of the Great Prism
flavorText: "When the long dark closes around us, we will be the last light." —Wei Ning

name: Lightkin Bond
flavorText: "My parents walked a hard road to get me to the Last City safely. They paid the price too. These Eliksni may be outsiders, but I see something familiar in 'em. Loss. Pain. Hope." —Amanda Holliday

name: Lightkin Boots
flavorText: "With the arrival of the Pyramids, and now these Eliksni joining us in the Last City, I can't help but feel like we haven't ever truly understood the war we're fighting. But I believe we are learning quickly now." —Commander Zavala

name: Lightkin Cloak
flavorText: "The way folks act toward the Eliksni shows you who they really are. Not sure if that's the worst or best part of this." —Amanda Holliday

name: Lightkin Cover
flavorText: "It has been a long time since Eliksni looked up at the Great Machine with hope. It is an honor to live in this moment." —Mithrax

name: Lightkin Gauntlets
flavorText: "Enemies become allies, that's just how it goes. Hell, most of my dearest friends killed me at one point or another!" —The Drifter

name: Lightkin Gloves
flavorText: "I got no qualms with them shackin' up here, but you ask me, they're wild for lookin' up to that big ball in the sky again. Didn't end well the last time around. Fool me once and all that." —The Drifter

name: Lightkin Greaves
flavorText: "Trust is built slowly, stone by stone. Like this City." —Commander Zavala

name: Lightkin Grips
flavorText: "Long as they don't cross me, I'm everybody's friend. Thing is, I feel like I get crossed more'n most." —The Drifter

name: Lightkin Helm
flavorText: "Even below this night, the ground has been warmed by the Great Machine." —Mithrax

name: Lightkin Mark
flavorText: "It ain't right to think wanting a better life for yourself and your kin is just a Human value." —Amanda Holliday

name: Lightkin Mask
flavorText: "A Sacred Splicer can change much, but I never dreamed our lives would change so quickly." —Mithrax

name: Lightkin Plate
flavorText: "We have more in common than we may realize, or be willing to admit." —Lord Shaxx

name: Lightkin Robes
flavorText: "I once defended this city from the Fallen. As did many Lights no longer with us today. Now these walls shelter the House of Light. I could be bitter… but there's something poetic in that." —Lord Shaxx

name: Lightkin Strides
flavorText: "I was asked if the City would protect the Traveler. I replied it is the Traveler who protects the City." —Commander Zavala

name: Lightkin Vest
flavorText: "A shield does as much damage as a sword if it is not protecting what you hold dear." —Lord Shaxx

name: Liminal Voyager Bond
flavorText: "There are whispers among the Warlocks who remain. Whispers of one who has seen the future in death." —The Journals of Jorin Nal

name: Liminal Voyager Boots
flavorText: "With every step, I wish I could return to the home I do not recall. But my duty is to fight." —The Journals of Jorin Nal

name: Liminal Voyager Gloves
flavorText: "I did not seek the Traveler's gift. It was thrust upon me. Still, I do not shrink from this power—I embrace it." —The Journals of Jorin Nal

name: Liminal Voyager Hood
flavorText: "I have seen the edges of eternity. It is full of bloodshed and isolation." —The Journals of Jorin Nal

name: Liminal Voyager Robes
flavorText: "It never strays far from my heart. The fear that I am… unworthy." —The Journals of Jorin Nal

name: Lion Rampant
flavorText: All expect that you should rouse yourself, as did the former lions of your blood.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Jump Jets
exoticPerk.description: Increases hip-fire range and accuracy for Primary ammo weapons. Grants additional aerial maneuverability and enables airborne firing during Lift. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

name: Lion's Pride
flavorText: "With fists like those, who needs guns? Everyone else, that's who!" —Lord Shaxx

name: Lion's Reign Mark
flavorText: When the world begins to crumble, they will look to you to hold up the sky.

name: Loreley Splendor Helm
flavorText:
"I don't know what it means
That I am so sad
A legend of bygone days
That I cannot keep out of my mind." —Die Lorelei, Heinrich Heine

exoticPerk.name: Cauterizing Flame
exoticPerk.description: While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade or becoming critically wounded with full class ability energy creates a Sunspot at your location.

exoticPerk.description: Upgrade this armor to Artifice armor to unlock this mod socket.

flavorText:
> No one has ever died wearing me.

exoticPerk.description: Arcbolt Grenades have increased chaining capabilities and jolt targets hit. Damaging combatants with jolt or applying jolt to targets grants additional Arcbolt Grenade energy.

name: Mantle of Battle Harmony
flavorText: There is no strength in letting go.

exoticPerk.name: Absorption Cells
exoticPerk.description: Final blows or sustained damage with weapons matching your equipped Super damage type grant you Super energy. When your Super energy is full, you instead gain a temporary bonus to weapon damage of that type. When you've exhausted your Super, matching elemental weapons' damage temporarily causes explosions around the target.

name: Mantle of Contests
flavorText: Drink deep from the cup of victory.

name: Mantle of Efrideet
flavorText: "Perun and Gheleon are so serious. Never yet seen a target I couldn't hit. What've I to worry about? " —Efrideet, before the Ironsbane
sourceString: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.

name: Mantle of the Cormorant Blade
flavorText: "Light isn't power. Light isn't magic. It's a skill. Be unthoughtful in its use and you will fail every time." —Warlock Aunor Mahal.

name: Mark Judgment
flavorText: "A signifier of force." —Emissary of the Nine

name: Mark Judgment (CODA)
flavorText: A forceful gift: for one who seeks answers about the Dark.

setBonuses.name: Between Poles
setBonuses.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.

setBonuses.name: So Very Thin
setBonuses.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.

name: Mark of Agony
flavorText: Acolytes of Nezarec: Briar - V

setBonuses.name: Bad Dreams
setBonuses.description: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.

setBonuses.name: Dream-Devourer
setBonuses.description: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.

name: Mark of Contests
flavorText: Drink deep from the cup of victory.

name: Mark of Medal
flavorText: Your reputation precedes you, like the rumble of a lumbering beast.

name: Mark of Nohr
flavorText: "What Calus found at the black edge… when he brings it to light, there will be a reckoning unlike anything this galaxy has ever seen." —Valus Nohr
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Mark of Optimacy
flavorText: Has this wealth found you or have you found it?

name: Mark of Remembrance
flavorText: To remind the flock that they are not forgotten.
sourceString: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.

name: Mark of Shelter
flavorText: Titans are both the shelter and the storm.
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: Mark of the Colliders
flavorText: "All is conflict. Stand your ground." —Oath of the Collision Order

name: Mark of the Emperor's Champion
flavorText: A gift for the Titan with Ghaul's strength.

name: Mark of the Exile
flavorText: "They who entered the Speaker's chambers as master and apprentice were bitter rivals when they left." —Brother Vance

name: Mark of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be feared.

setBonuses.name: Taken Barrier
setBonuses.description: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.

setBonuses.name: Taken Armaments
setBonuses.description: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.

name: Mark of the Pit
flavorText: Torn from a vanquished Wizard, it flutters in windless air.

name: Mark of the Taken King
flavorText: "If I fail, let me be worm food."

name: Mark of the Unassailable
flavorText: All are welcome. None shall pass.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Mark Relentless
flavorText: "For you as much as it is for them. They seek to observe your absolute force." —Emissary of the Nine
sourceString: Complete Trials tickets and earn rank-up packages from the Emissary of the Nine.

name: Mask of Bakris
flavorText: "I cast off my carapace to be reborn, just like our glorious Riis."  —Atraks-1, Fallen Exo

exoticPerk.name: Light Shift
exoticPerk.description: While you have a Stasis or Arc Super equipped, your Dodge becomes a longer range, faster moving shift that partially cloaks you during use. After shifting, your Stasis and Arc weapons gain a stacking damage bonus for a short time. Final blows with this bonus active refund class ability energy.

name: Mask of Detestation
flavorText: Acolytes of Nezarec: Acasia - I

name: Mask of Fealty
flavorText: Leave a mark.
sourceString: Solo Expert and Master Lost Sectors

exoticPerk.name: Null Factor
exoticPerk.description: Withering Blade hits and bounces create a small Stasis crystal and refund a portion of melee energy. Using Withering Blade to shatter crystals or frozen targets releases a spread of Withering Blades.

name: Mask of Feltroc
flavorText: "I can solve this. Give me a weapon." —Feltroc, the Skull-Piercer at the Battle of Kaga-Clipse
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Mask of Nohr
flavorText: "I'm a Valus before I'm a 'Shadow.' But Calus is the empire's last, best hope. His plan is my plan." —Valus Nohr
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Mask of Optimacy
flavorText: From high atop humanity we watch.

name: Mask of Righteousness
flavorText: "Why must I be wrong for you to be right?" —Rekkana, Warlock of the Kentarch 3

name: Mask of Rull
flavorText: “My planet was dead. The sky poisoned by war with an extrasolar enemy in a war that continued to rage. Then Calus came.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse

name: Mask of Sekris
flavorText: "Five Lights. Too many to fight. I loosed web grenades and fled." —Sekris, Baron of Shanks
sourceString: Leviathan, Eater of Worlds raid lair.

name: Mask of the Emperor's Agent
flavorText: The next time we meet.

name: Mask of the Flain
flavorText: – With knife in hand and violence in heart, a proposal is made and refused –

setBonuses.name: Sinew Stitching
setBonuses.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.

setBonuses.name: Knit Together
setBonuses.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.

name: Mask of the Fulminator
flavorText: “How does one convince a creature of pure, sentient energy to pledge her loyalty? The agency to leave home is intoxicating for anyone.” — Calus, Emperor of the Cabal

name: Mask of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be cunning.

name: Mask of the Quiet One
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Dreaded Visage
exoticPerk.description: Grants ability energy when you are damaged. While you have a Void super equipped, rapid final blows and final blows while critically wounded grant Devour.

name: Mask of the Taken King
flavorText: "What will happen if I die?"

name: Mask of Trepidation
flavorText: Acolytes of Nezarec: Koraxis - I

name: Massyrian's Draw
flavorText: A tribute worn in honor of the first among Heiro Sect; long since lost, long since remembered.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Mataiodoxía
flavorText: The moment when wings and limbs are held on tenterhooks, and the pin enters the thorax.

exoticPerk.name: Stylostixis
exoticPerk.description: Targets damaged by Arcane Needle emit a suspending detonation when defeated. Landing multiple Arcane Needles or Needlestorm on the same target immediately triggers a larger, more powerful detonation. Defeating suspended targets grants melee energy. Your Arcane Needles are strong against [Shield-Piercing]Barrier Champions.

name: Mechaneer's Tricksleeves
flavorText: "This won't end well for one of us. And darling, it won't be me." —Self-styled "Lady" Olu Alderdice
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Spring-Loaded Mounting
exoticPerk.description: Increases Sidearm airborne effectiveness, ready speed, and reload speed. While you're critically wounded, swapping to a Sidearm reloads it and increases its damage. While this effect is active, Sidearm final blows reload the weapon and extend the effect's duration.

name: Medal Bond
flavorText: Your reputation precedes you, like a hint of perfume on the breeze.

name: Medal Mantle
flavorText: Your reputation precedes you, like a disregarded warning.

name: Melas Panoplia
flavorText: "We need friends, and we need to make them first. Regardless, never keep your weapon out of close reach." —Director William Moffat

exoticPerk.name: Forge Master
exoticPerk.description: Collecting a Firesprite or rapid Solar final blows make you a Forge Master, allowing you to recall your Throwing Hammer. After impacting a target, recall your hammer at full intensity to perform a Perfect Recall, causing an explosion of forge slag. Perfect Recalls and collecting Firesprites extend your time as a Forge Master.

name: Memory of Cayde
flavorText: "Hey… take me with you." —Cayde-6

name: Memory of Cayde Cloak
flavorText: "Hey… take me with you." —Cayde-6

name: Memory of Cayde Mark
flavorText: "Hey… take me with you." —Cayde-6

exoticPerk.name: Seriously, Watch Out
exoticPerk.description: While your Juggernaut shield is active, you slowly gain Bolt Charge stacks over time and increased weapon ready speed. Sprinting while amplified creates an energizing field behind you that grants close by allies speed boost.

name: Moirai
flavorText: Fate is woven with death.

exoticPerk.name: Webcatcher
exoticPerk.description: Threaded Spike can bounce to Tangles, detonating them and returning immediately. Tangles detonated by Threaded Spike are rewoven and retrieved by it. Catches without a Tangle refund extra melee energy.

name: Moonfang-X7 Bond
flavorText: "X7… what happened to one through six? Probably in a dumpster somewhere. What a waste." —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Boots
flavorText: "Daito sure knows quality; I've never felt combat boots this soft. Welp, enjoy the luxury. Just another perk of knowing me." —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Chassis
flavorText: "The glasses down in Daito's R&D basement cooked up some wild trips. Not many see the light of day. Lucky for you, I'm an expert in acquisitions." —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Cloak
flavorText:
"What's with all the animals? Some Daito honcho wishin' they took more walks in the woods? Seems creepy to me."
—The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Crown
flavorText: "Wreath yourself in victory." —Daito product slogan

name: Moonfang-X7 Gauntlets
flavorText: RUNNING DIAGNOSTICS—L7 ACTUATORS… [PASSED] // INERTIA AMPLIFICATION GEL [88%] // SAFETY RELEASE MATRIX [status unknown]

name: Moonfang-X7 Gloves
flavorText: "Feel that material? That silky smoothness is 100% genuine Awoken Star-silk. Guaranteed." —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Greaves
flavorText: "You know what velocity refractors are? Me neither, but the manual says this baby's got six of 'em!" —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Grips
flavorText:
Be fleet as a fox with Daito's new Vulpina Actuators, the perfect combination of weight efficiency and grip strength.
—Daito product manual

name: Moonfang-X7 Helm
flavorText: "Daddy Daito locked this old soul up in the warehouse when margins got too tight. I'm just here to liberate it." —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Mark
flavorText: "Remember, this week's password = Tall Shields/Broken Waves/With Grace/Grey Claw" —Torn page from Daito R&D notebook

name: Moonfang-X7 Mask
flavorText: CHECKING FOR FIRMWARE UPDATES… // NO CONNECTION // 8592 DAYS SINCE LAST UPDATE

name: Moonfang-X7 Rig
flavorText:
"Like old Drifter's gonna let this collect dust on a shelf just cause of some failed safety tests… Don't they know what we're dealing with?"
—The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Robe
flavorText: "Daito's property? You only own a thing 'till someone takes it from you. So nah, this beauty belongs to you now." —The Drifter

name: Moonfang-X7 Strides
flavorText:
"I almost kept these. Fit my tired feet real nice. Who am I kiddin' though? Drifter always takes care of his friends."
—The Drifter

name: Mothkeeper's Wraps
flavorText: Smother the lights and run.

exoticPerk.name: Winged Eclipse
exoticPerk.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.

name: Mouth of Ur
flavorText: For the more Light the worms consume, the hungrier they become.

flavorText: "The Vex don't really want to kill you. It's just that one of the by-products of conversion is death. Shame, huh?" —Sagira

name: Omega Mechanos Plate
flavorText: "And a version of you would still be alive in a Vex simulation somewhere. So it's only sort of like death, really." —Sagira

name: Omega Mechanos Robes
flavorText: "And a version of you would still be alive in a Vex simulation somewhere. So it's only sort of like death, really." —Sagira

name: Omega Mechanos Strides
flavorText: "And Ghosts? I don't think they really understand what we are. Light is pretty hard to simulate. Paracausality and all that." —Sagira

name: Omega Mechanos Vest
flavorText: "And a version of you would still be alive in a Vex simulation somewhere. So it's only sort of like death, really." —Sagira

name: Omnioculus

exoticPerk.name: Praxic Lift
exoticPerk.description:
You gain an air move jetpack. Weapon and Arc powered melee final blows build up Jetpack Fuel.

While airborne, [Air Dodge] : Charge your jetpack.

On release, activate your jetpack with a forceful blast of exhausting Arc energy then fly forward a short distance based on the amount charged. Collide with a combatant to unleash a blinding blast of energy and gain a temporary bonus to your melee stat.

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Bond

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Boots
flavorText: "I walk without hesitation toward my destiny." —Shayura, Awoken Warlock

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Cloak
flavorText: "We can't ever go back to the way things were." —Aisha, Human Hunter

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Gauntlets
flavorText: "A fireteam is a family. Sometimes, family fails." —Reed-7, Exo Titan

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Gloves
flavorText: "I cannot be absolved."—Shayura, Awoken Warlock

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Grasps
flavorText: "I could have done more. Should have done more." —Aisha, Human Hunter

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Greaves
flavorText: "If I could do everything over again, walk in my shoes a second time, I would do it all differently." —Reed-7, Exo Titan

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Helm
flavorText: "Under a sturdy enough helmet, no one can see how damaged you are." —Reed-7, Exo Titan

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Hood
flavorText: "I see with eyes unclouded." —Shayura, Awoken Warlock

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Mark
flavorText: "No matter how strong you are, there will always be a weight too heavy to carry alone." —Reed-7, Exo Titan

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Mask

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Plate
flavorText: "I have died for my fireteam, but I never once thought to live for them." —Reed-7, Exo Titan

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Strides
flavorText: "There is nowhere to run." —Aisha, Human Hunter

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Vest
flavorText: "When you lose your faith, you lose a part of yourself." —Aisha, Human Hunter

name: Pyrrhic Ascent Vestment
flavorText: "I hold faith in the Light, unwavering."—Shayura, Awoken Warlock

name: Qiao's Care

name: Qiao's Grin

name: Qiao's Passing
flavorText: "Bind yourself with compassion and knowledge."

name: Qiao's Strides
flavorText: "Walk in peace, and know that there can be no danger in wisdom."

name: Quilted Winter Mark

sourceString: Earned during the seasonal Dawning event.

name: Racer's Bond

setBonuses.name: Dielectric Drift
setBonuses.description: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.

name: Racer's Mark

flavorText: Built for swift movement, they provide unexpected and decisive social benefits.

exoticPerk.name: The Dance
exoticPerk.description:
Moderately increases airborne effectiveness and hip fire mobility, range, and accuracy for weapons that use Primary ammo.

Final blows with Primary ammo weapons return dodge energy, which can overflow to create additional charges when full.

name: Raiden Flux
flavorText: Interfaces with synapses (or nearest equivalent) to draw electric power directly from the wearer's body.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Synapse Junctions

name: Raiju's Harness

sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

name: Rain of Fire
flavorText: Coming in hot.

exoticPerk.description: Air dodge reloads all of your weapons and improves the airborne effectiveness of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles; final blows with these weapons make you radiant. name: Raptor's Bond

name: Reach of the Flain

sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

exoticPerk.name: Nightmare Fuel
exoticPerk.description: Powered melee and finisher final blows grant Nightmare Fuel, increasing handling and airborne effectiveness. While active, freshly drawn weapons deal additional damage and grant Nightmare Fuel on final blows. Gaining Nightmare Fuel reloads all holstered weapons.

name: Secant Filaments
flavorText: The nature of the secant is to intercept a curve, a role all human relationships likewise fill.

exoticPerk.name: Devouring Rift
exoticPerk.description: While using a Void Super, casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Damage dealt by you and your allies from within your Empowering Rift will [Disruption] disrupt combatants. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants you class ability energy.

name: Second Chance
flavorText: Do you deserve it?

exoticPerk.name: Myrmidon's Reach
exoticPerk.description: Gain a second charge of your Shield Throw melee. Your Shield Throws now weaken targets, create a Void Breach on final blows, and become shield-piercing, stunning [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and refunding a Shield Throw charge when you do. Picking up a Void Breach grants you Shield Throw energy.

name: Serpent's Glory Mantle
flavorText: At the far edge of everything they know, only you will recognize what awaits.

name: Seventh Seraph Bond
flavorText: "You can't leave me. Not like this." —First Lieutenant Artur Voronin

name: Seventh Seraph Boots
flavorText: Salvation, at last.

setBonuses.name: Rasputin's Wrath
setBonuses.description: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.

setBonuses.name: Rasputin's Reprisal
setBonuses.description:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

name: Shadow's Bond
flavorText: “The Fulminator could directly afflict the nervous system of the organics around her. She was pain in all its shades. I will miss her.” —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal

name: Shadow's Boots
flavorText: "The task before us is staggering. We must unite all races and creeds. We shall win them to our side with words where we can. And with your Light where we cannot." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Cloak
flavorText: “With the death of the Ace-Defiant, the Leviathan is without a master helmsman. If I must wait another millennium for a replacement, I shall.” —Emperor Calus

name: Shadow's Gauntlets
flavorText: "With my knowledge of the future and all that you've seen and done… The victories borne of it… What can stop us at the end of all things?" —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Gloves
flavorText: "With my knowledge of the future and all that you've seen and done… The wisdom borne of it… What can stop us at the end of all things?" —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Greaves
flavorText: "…The future can't be fought. I know it. You know it. But that won't stop you from trying."  —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Grips
flavorText: "With my knowledge of the future and all that you've seen and done… The silence borne of it… What can stop us at the end of all things?" —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Helm
flavorText: "The mysteries of the universe lie before you. Unresolved. Threatening. You and I will face them together. As true Cabal." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Mark
flavorText: “Calus could not heal our air. My planet is still dying. But as long as I serve, I have hope.” —Rull, Gun of Kaga Clipse.

name: Shadow's Mask
flavorText: "The athenaeum worlds lie before you. Everything from the Empire of old that was—and has been lost. You and I will rediscover them together. As true Cabal." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Mind
flavorText: "The mysteries of the universe lie before you. Unresolved. Threatening. You and I will face them together. As true Cabal." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Plate
flavorText: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I shall uphold the pillars of existence until the end comes. And when it does…" —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Robes
flavorText: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I are pillars of this existence, and shall be until all comes crashing down." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Strides
flavorText: "All that we've left in the athenaeum catalogs are suitable proxies for all the powers of this system. I've simply forgotten how to reach them. I'm not who I was. I need you." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shadow's Vest
flavorText: "Nothing. Nothing can stop us. You and I shall take back the pillars of existence from the lost athenaeum worlds." —Emperor Calus
sourceString: Acquired from the raid "Crown of Sorrow."

name: Shards of Galanor
flavorText:
"Galanor is beyond my skill to repair."
"…I can work with this."
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Sharp Edges
exoticPerk.description: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion; releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage will return Super energy after the Super ends.

name: Shattered Vault Cloak
flavorText: The machines are not invincible.

name: Shinobu's Vow
flavorText: "No supplies. Armor in tatters. But the refugees had asked for help. And she had given her word." —Tale of the Six Coyotes
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: New Tricks
exoticPerk.description: Gain an additional Skip Grenade charge. Skip Grenade damage grants Bolt Chargeand gaining Bolt Charge grants Skip Grenade energy. When Bolt Charge is ready, you heal nearby allies and enhance your next Skip Grenade.

name: Shrewd Survivor Bond
flavorText: When none have come before you, you will forge your own path.

setBonuses.name: Reflex Action
setBonuses.description: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.

setBonuses.name: Hotshot
setBonuses.description: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.

name: Shrewd Survivor Boots
flavorText: You can run from the past, but it always seems to catch up anyways.
