name: Shroud of Flies
flavorText: They gather where death steps.

setBonuses.name: Cursed Fist
setBonuses.description: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.

setBonuses.name: Power of the Son
setBonuses.description: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.

name: Simulator Boots
flavorText: "I saw her! I saw her! No, send me back, I saw her!" —RECORD 453-CHASM-7377

name: Simulator Gauntlets
flavorText: "As in the other timelines we examined, where the simulation includes our intervention, the City survives. Where it does not, well..." —RECORD 116-CHASM-0064

name: Simulator Gloves
flavorText: "I see a submerged Earth. I see humanity in crude boats, battered, drifting. I see them fight what rises from the deeps. Fight and win." —RECORD 463-CHASM-3102

name: Simulator Greaves
flavorText: "I see the City, ruined and abandoned. I see no Traveler in the sky. The war is elsewhere. Let us find it." —RECORD 615-CHASM-2110

name: Simulator Grips
flavorText: "Visualization was unexpectedly drawn toward images suggestive of the past. Experiment terminated at lead investigator's frantic demand." —RECORD 457-CHASM-7002

name: Simulator Helm
flavorText: "The face of war continues to change. In this timeline, Cabal. In another, Vex. And in this other one—we have no name for what we saw." —RECORD 614-CHASM-8299

name: Simulator Hood
flavorText: "Her back is always turned to us. It's almost as if she knows we're watching." —RECORD 459-CHASM-1002

name: Simulator Legs
flavorText: "Many Ghosts, whispering like a stream. I walked among them, listening, but could not understand." —RECORD 460-CHASM-1022

name: Simulator Mask
flavorText: "It's not inevitable, is it? What I saw? Please say it's not." —RECORD 451-CHASM-7037

name: Simulator Plate
flavorText: "In this vision we are victorious. In this vision also. And this one. And this." —RECORD 115-CHASM-8991

name: Simulator Robes
flavorText: "She just fainted? Didn't say anything? No, 'great wyrm' doesn't mean anything to me."  —RECORD 462-CHASM-3103

name: Simulator Vest
flavorText: "Flames. Ice. Floods. Whirlwinds. Earthquakes. Eruptions. Destruction and despair." —RECORD 458-CHASM-7121

name: Skerren Corvus Cloak
flavorText: Only the finest of threads are worn for the harvest.

name: Skerren Corvus Grasps
flavorText: The defender holds you up to distract.

name: Skerren Corvus Mask
flavorText: Growth in the field is achieved by outwitting the enemy.

name: Skerren Corvus Strides
flavorText: Standing strong as the great protector of this land.

name: Skerren Corvus Vest
flavorText: You can peck, but it will not yield.

name: Skull of Dire Ahamkara
flavorText: Reality is the finest flesh, oh bearer mine. And are you not…hungry?
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Actual Grandeur
exoticPerk.description:
After casting a Nova Bomb, briefly gain a free cast of a fast-moving but weaker Nova Bomb: Lance. Your Nova Bomb: Cataclysm is empowered if detonated with another Nova Bomb. 
Nova Bomb final blows and weapon final blows while you have Devour grant Super energy.

name: Skull of the Flain
flavorText: – With knife in hand and violence in heart, a proposal is made and refused –

name: Skybreaker Bond
flavorText: Radiance is veiled, lest it scorch the eyes of the beholder.

name: Skybreaker Boots
flavorText: Division of earth and sky forestalls strife.

name: Skybreaker Gloves
flavorText: The falcon lives and dies by its talons.

name: Skybreaker Hood
flavorText: It is not the moon's place to outshine the sun.

name: Skybreaker Robes
flavorText: Look upon my truth, and cower.

name: Smoke Jumper Bond
flavorText: Ashes to ashes.

name: Sovereign Boots
flavorText: "With steadfast pace and upright bearing, we and those who follow us shall prevail." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 9
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Gauntlets
flavorText: "Executors shall uphold the rights of others with all their strength until a greater leader arises to take that burden." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Gloves
flavorText: "The hand of the law must fall impartially on the rich and the poor, the powerful and the weak. This is required of both rulers and the Executors who serve them." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Greaves
flavorText: "In your long search, remember that true leaders inspire others to follow. Tyrants may exercise petty power, but they will be abandoned before long." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 13
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Grips
flavorText: "With stout and unfailing arm, Executors shall defend the principles of monarchy to all who challenge them." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 6
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Helm
flavorText: "To serve as an Executor is to stand as a pillar of the City. Hold your head high." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 2
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Hood
flavorText: "We pursue an unrealized ideal, but we do so clearly, without illusions." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 9
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Legs
flavorText: "The time to walk away from a poor candidate is before the crown is offered. Executors must test and dismiss many thousands without guarantee of success." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 10
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Mask
flavorText: "Above all, Executors must cultivate perceptiveness, for without this, kings and queens might walk before our faces and we would not see." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 3
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Plate
flavorText: "Opportunities will arise to profit from our mission, to accrue personal power and wealth. Decline them." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 12
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Robes
flavorText: "While our wealth is not meant for personal use, we should remember that a taste of luxury can be instructive, even persuasive." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 13
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Sovereign Vest
flavorText: "In seeking a true leader, the Executor must test the heart of each candidate, sifting through the weak, foolish, and evil for the good." —Laws of the Executors, Vol. 13
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Executor Hideo.

name: Speaker's Sight

exoticPerk.name: The Lost Voice
exoticPerk.description: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret. Healing allies occasionally spawns an Orb of Power.

name: Speedloader Slacks
flavorText: "The way you move in those makes me self-conscious."

exoticPerk.name: Tight Fit
exoticPerk.description: Dodging instantly reloads all your weapons and grants increased reload and handling to you and nearby allies. While the buff is active, additional dodges increase the buff strength and refresh the timer, maxing out at 5 stacks. Dealing sustained damage grants class ability energy.

name: St0mp-EE5
flavorText: "I call them the Stompies! For when your legs need that extra kick." —Marcus Ren
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Hydraulic Boosters
exoticPerk.description: Increases slide distance and improves High Jump, Strafe Jump, and Triple Jump. Take less damage from targets when airborne.

name: Star-Crossed Fists
flavorText: "Told my new recruits about your fisticuffs in Meridian Bay. One of 'em didn't believe me. Wanna give him a talking to?" —Holborn to Wei Ning

name: Star-Crossed Footsteps
flavorText: "When I'm lost I think, what would Wei Ning do? And she always has an answer for me." —Callisto Yin

name: Star-Crossed Heart
flavorText: "It's you." —Wei Ning to Eriana-3

name: Star-Crossed Helm
flavorText: "I said 'use your head!' and then she… well, I think you get it." —Pahanin

name: Star-Crossed Mark
flavorText: You don't even have to ask. I'd follow you to the end of the galaxy. —Wei Ning

name: Star-Eater Scales
flavorText: Feast on the sky. Gorge yourself until all starlight has been gnawed to black—then the cosmos will tremble with your roar.

exoticPerk.name: Feast of Light
exoticPerk.description: You gain additional Super energy from Orbs of Power you pick up. While your Super energy is full, picking up an Orb of Power overcharges your Super, causing you to gain a burst of healing when cast and a bonus to your Super damage. At maximum overcharge, you also gain an overshield.

name: Starfire Protocol
flavorText: 13.4 billion years ago, the first stars kindled out of darkness, seeding the future of all life.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Fusion Harness
exoticPerk.description: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.

name: Stella Incognita Bond
flavorText: "At the point of decision, the Arach must lead us to safety in the midst of the unknown." —The Book of Departures, Canto II
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Stella Incognita Cloak
flavorText: "One day an Arach, triumphant, will oversee a mass departure. The Arach's purpose thus turns from persuasion to selection. Our future home must be chosen with care." —The Book of Departures, Canto II
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Stella Incognita Mark
flavorText: "In choosing the site of a new home, consider not only natural resources and environmental dangers, but also the fuel levels of your ships." —The Book of Departures, Canto II
sourceString: Earn rank-up packages from Arach Jalaal.

name: Stoicism
flavorText: We are the final stand. The fortress in the storm.

exoticPerk.name: Spirit of Severance
exoticPerk.description: Powered melee or finisher final blows unleash a damaging explosion.

name: Stormdancer's Brace
flavorText: After all, isn't lightning better outside the bottle?

exoticPerk.name: Ascending Amplitude
exoticPerk.description: Stormtrance hits and final blows increase the damage it deals. Refunds Super energy when it ends. While Stormtrance is equipped, ability damage while amplified grants Bolt Charge.

name: Strides of Ascendancy
flavorText: "You said we'd dance through time—reel through realities—together. You can't stop now." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3

name: Strides of the Great Hunt
flavorText: I wish to be swift.

name: Strides of the Taken King
flavorText: "If I am defeated on my throne, then I will die. My work will end."

name: Stronghold
flavorText: I am a shield unto myself.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Clenched Fist
exoticPerk.description: Maximizes guard stats on equipped Heavy ammo Swords. You take reduced damage while blocking with a Sword. Rapidly damaging targets after blocking shots with a Sword grants Restoration for a duration determined by the number of shots blocked.

name: Sunstead Gauntlets (Magnificent)
flavorText: Complete any raid to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Sunstead Gauntlets (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete Altars of Sorrow on the Moon, or Override missions from Season of the Splicer.
- Gain elemental empowerment buffs by collecting Elemental Orbs.
- Defeat combatants with Solar weapons.

name: Sunstead Greaves (Magnificent)
flavorText: Defeat Champions or defeat Guardians in Competitive Crucible (Trials or Glory Rank playlists) to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Sunstead Greaves (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Complete public events on Europa or Battlegrounds from Season of the Chosen.
- Collect Void or Stasis Elemental Orbs in strike, Crucible, or Gambit playlists.
- Defeat combatants with melee attacks while using a Void subclass.

name: Sunstead Helm (Magnificent)
flavorText: Complete Vanguard Ops on Master or Grandmaster difficulty to enable this armor's white glow.

name: Sunstead Helm (Majestic)
flavorText:
During Solstice 2021:
- Defeat 5 minibosses in the European Aerial Zone before the boss is summoned.
- Collect Elemental Orbs.
- Rapidly defeat combatants.

name: Sunstead Mark (Magnificent)

setBonuses.name: Network Admin
setBonuses.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.

setBonuses.name: Network Upload
setBonuses.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.

name: Terra Concord Fists
flavorText: "Use your surroundings, they said. Don't think they meant 'build armor out of a crashed space base,' but here we are."
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Terra Concord Greaves
flavorText:
"Earth's destiny is to move beyond the Earth."

"It was. Now we turn space stations into battle armor."
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Terra Concord Helm
flavorText: "The shining halls of peace have been torn down and turned into the battered plate of war."
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Terra Concord Mark
flavorText: The orbital city of Caer Lerion was one of Earth's crowning achievements in the Golden Age.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Terra Concord Plate
flavorText: "Peace is achievable. How do I know? We have achieved it before."
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Tesseract Trace IV
flavorText: Geometry is the study of perfect beauty.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Tesseract Trace IV
flavorText: To unravel the deepest mysteries, begin with the simple beauty of the geometric line.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Tesseract Trace IV
flavorText: The Traveler's arrival rewrote every single theory we used to hold about the Universe and its ways.
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Tesseract Trace IV
flavorText: "How to understand the Traveler? Do as it does: travel." —The Stoic
sourceString: Open Legendary engrams and earn faction rank-up packages.

name: Tethering Void
flavorText: All that has been given in sacrifice shall find its way home.

name: The Beyond
flavorText: Seek the forces outside the Light and Dark.

name: The Bombardiers
flavorText: "Tallulah Fairwind never turns down a dare." —Tallulah Fairwind
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Parting Gift
exoticPerk.description:
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it and creating a secondary effect based on your Super's element:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Suppresses targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.

name: The Dragon's Shadow
flavorText: "It is my honor." —Chalco Yong to Ikora Rey
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Wraithmetal Mail
exoticPerk.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging temporarily increases this benefit, reloads your equipped weapon from reserves, grants improved movement speed, and increases your class ability stat.

name: The Path of Burning Steps
flavorText: Those who walk through fire have burned away their fear.

exoticPerk.name: Firewalker
exoticPerk.description: Increase the damage of Solar weapons and Solar Ignitions based on the amount of Roaring Flames stacks you have. You are harder to suspend, slow, or freeze, and when you break out, you take no damage from doing so, creating a burst of Solar energy around yourself.

name: The Shelter in Place
flavorText: Some armor doesn't protect you so much as it just makes the dying slower.
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: The Shelter in Place
flavorText: "That each of us have many lives to give for the City is the Traveler's greatest gift." —Zavala
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: The Shelter in Place
flavorText: "Where is your home? That is where you will fight the hardest." —Zavala

name: The Shelter in Place

name: The Stag

exoticPerk.description: Your Rift provides damage reduction to allied Guardians standing in it. Grants Rift energy when you are critically wounded. On your death, creates a healing rift on your corpse.

name: The Took Offense
flavorText: This armor may not be as thick as rhino hide, but it does smell better. That's something.
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: The Took Offense
flavorText: "Ten paces, sidearms or Hand Cannons only. Usually to the third rez. Do NOT target Ghosts." —"Duels for the Road" by Cayde-6
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: The Took Offense
flavorText: Hunters are big on the "outrageous fortune." Emphasis on outrage. And fortune.
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: The Took Offense
flavorText: It's all good fun… until it's not.
sourceString: Complete strikes and earn rank-up packages from Commander Zavala.

name: The Took Offense
flavorText: The best defense is offense, because then your enemy's dead. The second-best defense is good armor.

name: Thunderhead Bond
flavorText: "Our legacy lifts us up, so we have the strength to extend our hands to the future. No Cloud Strider truly fights alone." —Rohan, Cloud Strider

name: Thunderhead Boots
flavorText: "That's what it's all about, right? You only ever see the seeds. The plants are for the children. Metaphorically." —Myriadical, Cloud Strider

name: Thunderhead Cover

name: Thunderhead Gauntlets

name: Tireless Striders
flavorText: If there is no road, then it cannot be long.

name: TM-Cogburn Custom Cover
flavorText: Tex Mechanica custom-made armored cover. Headstrong, perfect for a charging bull.

setBonuses.name: Old Martian Diplomacy
setBonuses.description: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.

setBonuses.name: High Noon
setBonuses.description: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.

name: TM-Cogburn Custom Legguards

name: TM-Cogburn Custom Mark

name: TM-Cogburn Custom Plate

name: TM-Earp Custom Chaps

name: TM-Earp Custom Cloaked Stetson

sourceString: Eliminate all Barons on the Tangled Shore.

name: Transversive Steps
flavorText: Your relationship with consistent spacetime is...tenuous at best.

exoticPerk.name: Strange Protractor
exoticPerk.description: Sprint speed increased. After a short time sprinting, your currently equipped weapon is automatically reloaded.

name: Tread of the Hezen Lords
flavorText: Rumor has it that the exile Osiris came too close to understanding the Vex.

setBonuses.name: Radiolaria Breach
setBonuses.description: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.

setBonuses.name: Collective Power
setBonuses.description: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

name: Triton Vice
flavorText: With this, I topple Heracles.

exoticPerk.name: Halberdier's Reach
exoticPerk.description: Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded. Glaive melee final blows overflow a round to the magazine. Glaive projectile final blows detonate in an explosion.

name: Turris Shade Gauntlets
flavorText: "Leaders. Elite infantry. Martial teachers. Your tribe would make stunning Shadows." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Turris Shade Greaves
flavorText: "There has only ever been but a single Shadow from each people I've encountered. Yet there are so many Lights, and I have so little time…" —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal.
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Turris Shade Helm
flavorText: "You have truly grown fat from strength. Magnificent." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Turris Shade Mark
flavorText: "This serves as a message to all false Cabal that you have served me. They won't show it, but they fear you. And they should." —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Turris Shade Plate
flavorText: A little stronger. A more powerful stance. You are almost ready… to cast a Shadow. —Calus, Emperor of the Cabal
sourceString: Leviathan, Spire of Stars raid lair.

name: Tusked Allegiance Bond
flavorText: "I do not sit and theologize my enemies. I crush them." —Empress Caiatl

name: Tusked Allegiance Boots
flavorText: "We stand with the Vanguard. No outside force will break what we have wrought." —Empress Caiatl

name: Tusked Allegiance Cloak
flavorText: "You'd think I'd understand it better than anyone, right? But I don't understand anything anymore." —Crow

name: Tusked Allegiance Gauntlets
flavorText: "If this is a test, we shall not fail." —Lord Saladin

name: Tusked Allegiance Gloves
flavorText: "Bonds are forged on the battlefield and broken at the War Table." —Empress Caiatl

name: Tusked Allegiance Greaves
flavorText: "Meet them head-on. Let us see whose Light burns more brightly." —Lord Saladin

name: Tusked Allegiance Grips
flavorText: "I don't think any of us will be the same when this is over." —Crow

name: Tusked Allegiance Helmet
flavorText: "They are an insult, a stain that's our duty to wash away." —Lord Saladin

name: Tusked Allegiance Hood
flavorText: "They have succeeded, somehow. But they will succeed no longer." —Empress Caiatl

name: Tusked Allegiance Mark
flavorText: "We are what we survive. They will not be the Guardians." —Lord Saladin

name: Tusked Allegiance Mask
flavorText: "When I look at them, I see myself staring back." —Crow

name: Tusked Allegiance Plate
flavorText: "I believed not that the Light was good, but that there is goodness in those who defend it. I still do." —Lord Saladin

name: Tusked Allegiance Robes
flavorText: "Were the Light a glory to be earned, the Cabal would have claimed it long ago." —Empress Caiatl

name: Tusked Allegiance Strides
flavorText: "Glint says to keep moving. That's how you know something's wrong." —Crow

name: Tusked Allegiance Vest
flavorText: "If they're truly worthy, if it's something they deserve, let them prove it." —Crow

name: Twisting Echo Cloak
flavorText: To make the old path your own.

name: Twisting Echo Grips
flavorText: To undertake vile means to carve a greater end.

name: Twisting Echo Mask
flavorText: To act free of conscience.

name: Twisting Echo Strides

exoticPerk.name: Tome of Dawn
exoticPerk.description: While you have a [Solar]Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and [Solar]Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

name: Wolfswood Bond
flavorText: Under a red dawn, the Iron Wolves gathered beneath the Ironwood.
sourceString: Complete Iron Banner matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Saladin.

flavorText: In our darkest hour, nine Iron Wolves emerged from the ruins.

name: Wormgod Caress
flavorText:
"Have you ever stared into the green soulfire flame? There is terror, but also… something warm."
—Eris Morn
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Burning Fists
exoticPerk.description: Defeating a target with melee or a finisher grants escalating melee damage, which decays over time. Higher levels of Burning Fists grant increased weapon damage.

name: Wormhusk Crown
flavorText: We strive to know infinity, and sharpen our minds on the whetstone of the impossible.
sourceString: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.

exoticPerk.name: Burning Souls
exoticPerk.description: Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapid [Solar]Solar final blows grant stacks of Burning Souls that increase Solar ability damage, increase the potency of Dodge's healing, and spreads the healing to nearby allies.
